text.p: The following are the main stories from Thursday morning's Slovenian newspapers:
- Slovenian Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek started a two-day visit to Spain on Wednesday. He will meet Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar and the Spanish king Juan Carlos.
- Foreign Minister Zoran Thaler met Russia's deputy foreign minister who arrived on a two-day visit to Slovenia on Wednesday.
- Over 50 defence experts will participate in an international conference called "Central and Eastern Europe and Euro-Atlantic Security" that starts in Ljubljana on Friday.

- The average number of unemployed Slovenians this year is expected to rise by 2.3 percent, a survey by the the Slovenian Employment Office said. In February, Slovenian unemployment eased by 0.1 percent to 14.5 percent.
- Slovenia's Smelt Olimpija faces French Asvel in the match for the third place of the basketball EuroLeague on Thursday.

- Trading companies in 1996 employed 13.2 percent of the total number of employed Slovenians, trading firms' net profit represented 22.9 percent of the economy's total net profit, the Payment Agency said.
- Slovenia's only airline Adria Airways said on Wednesday it will start regular flights to the Macedonian resort of Ohrid once a week from May 6.
